source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第五节

authorship: Project-authored chest-region stage illustrations based on the cited textbook narrative; not measured patient data or validated disease presets

stages.HyperacuteInjury: reference projected QRS scaled 125%, width 120%; fused J250/peak800uV at 60% of J-to-QT
stages.AcuteMonophasic: QS; fused J500/peak650uV at 65% of J-to-QT
stages.AcuteQInvertedT: Q with reduced R; J200/ST-end100uV; T -500uV
stages.SubacuteDeepT: Q with reduced R; ST0; T -500uV
stages.SubacuteRecoveringT: Q with reduced R; ST0; T -200uV
stages.OldQNormalT: Q with reduced R; ST0; reference projected T
stages.OldQInvertedT: Q with reduced R; ST0; T -150uV
stages.OldQLowT: Q with reduced R; ST0; T50uV

limitations: Manual snapshots, no automatic time course, treatment response or Q disappearance model. Q width follows selected QRS duration and is not classified by a detector. Chest-only selection retains unselected leads; no inferior/reciprocal territory model. Preserve patient QT endpoint and P/U. Stage values override selected ST/T/QRS controls.
